intro.text: A number sign (#) is used with this entry because of evidence that autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene (600465) on chromosome 10q21.2.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 (MRT37) is caused by homozygous mutation in the ANK3 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: The paper links a homozygous ANK3 mutation to intellectual disability. The MRT37 label is OMIM's name for this disorder and does not appear in the paper.

checks.claim: The ANK3 gene is located on chromosome 10q21.2.
checks.evidence_quote: AnkyrinG, encoded by the ANK3 gene, is involved in neuronal development and signaling.
checks.explanation: The abstract does not give the chromosomal location. Under the rules, standard chromosomal-location nomenclature for the gene counts as supported.

paragraphs.text: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by moderate intellectual disability, an attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)-like phenotype, and behavioral problems (Iqbal et al., 2013).

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 is a neurodevelopmental disorder.
checks.evidence_quote: illustrate the genetic and molecular relation between a wide range of neurodevelopmental disorders
checks.explanation: The paper treats the ANK3-related phenotypes as neurodevelopmental disorders.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 is characterized by moderate intellectual disability.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper reports moderate intellectual disability in the affected family.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 is characterized by an attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD)-like phenotype.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper reports an ADHD-like phenotype in the affected family.

checks.claim: Autosomal recessive intellectual developmental disorder-37 is characterized by behavioral problems.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper reports behavioral problems in the affected family.

paragraphs.text: Iqbal et al. (2013) described a consanguineous family in which affected members had moderate intellectual disability, an ADHD-like phenotype, and behavioral problems.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) described a consanguineous family with MRT37.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper describes a consanguineous family with this phenotype.

checks.claim: Affected members of the consanguineous family with MRT37 described by Iqbal et al. (2013) had moderate intellectual disability.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper reports moderate intellectual disability in the family.

checks.claim: Affected members of the consanguineous family with MRT37 described by Iqbal et al. (2013) had an ADHD-like phenotype.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper reports an ADHD-like phenotype in the family.

checks.claim: Affected members of the consanguineous family with MRT37 described by Iqbal et al. (2013) had behavioral problems.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems
checks.explanation: The paper reports behavioral problems in the family.

paragraphs.text: The finding of a homozygous ANK3 mutation in a consanguineous family by Iqbal et al. (2013) was compatible with autosomal recessive inheritance of MRT37.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) found a homozygous ANK3 mutation in a consanguineous family with MRT37.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: The paper reports a homozygous mutation in a consanguineous family.

checks.claim: The finding of a homozygous ANK3 mutation in a consanguineous family is compatible with autosomal recessive inheritance of MRT37.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation
checks.explanation: The abstract never says 'autosomal recessive', but a homozygous mutation in a consanguineous family is directly consistent with recessive inheritance.

paragraphs.text: In affected members of a consanguineous family with MRT37, Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the ANK3 gene. The mutation lay in the longest isoform of the gene. In the same report, Iqbal et al. (2013) described an unrelated patient with borderline intelligence and behavioral abnormalities in whom ANK3 was disrupted by a balanced translocation. They proposed that ANK3 disruption lies at the crossroads of neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) identified a homozygous ANK3 mutation in affected members of a consanguineous family with MRT37.
checks.evidence_quote: in a consanguineous family with moderate intellectual disability (ID), an ADHD-like phenotype and behavioral problems, we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: The paper reports a homozygous ANK3 mutation in this family.

checks.claim: The ANK3 mutation identified by Iqbal et al. (2013) in the consanguineous MRT37 family is a truncating frameshift mutation.
checks.evidence_quote: we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: The paper describes the mutation as a truncating frameshift.

checks.claim: The ANK3 frameshift mutation identified by Iqbal et al. (2013) in the consanguineous MRT37 family lies in the longest isoform of the ANK3 gene.
checks.evidence_quote: we identified a homozygous truncating frameshift mutation in the longest isoform of the same gene
checks.explanation: The paper places the mutation in the longest isoform.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) described an unrelated patient with borderline intelligence and behavioral abnormalities.
checks.evidence_quote: In a patient with a borderline intelligence, severe attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism and sleeping problems, all isoforms of the ANK3 gene, were disrupted by a balanced translocation.
checks.explanation: The paper describes a patient with borderline intelligence plus ADHD, autism and sleep problems, which the draft summarizes as behavioral abnormalities. The abstract refers to 'the two families', so this patient is from a separate family.

checks.claim: In the unrelated patient with borderline intelligence described by Iqbal et al. (2013), ANK3 was disrupted by a balanced translocation.
checks.evidence_quote: all isoforms of the ANK3 gene, were disrupted by a balanced translocation
checks.explanation: The paper states that a balanced translocation disrupted ANK3 in this patient.

checks.claim: Iqbal et al. (2013) proposed that ANK3 disruption lies at the crossroads of neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders.
checks.evidence_quote: Homozygous and heterozygous disruptions of ANK3: at the crossroads of neurodevelopmental and psychiatric disorders.
checks.explanation: The paper's title states this idea.
